claims.claim: All L1 gold records across the visible contexts report human oral bioavailability values of at least 45% (LY2196044 45%, alfuzosin 49%, rimegepant 64%, trametinib 72%, regorafenib 69-83%, encainide 76-78%, apalutamide ~100%, safinamide 95%, MMV693183 predicted 96%), all above the 20% threshold.

L2 records from the same contexts are consistent with high F: trametinib 72% absolute, regorafenib 69-83% absolute, rimegepant ~64% absolute, apalutamide ~100% absolute, LY2196044 41-74% across species, alfuzosin ~49% fed, and MMV693183 64-121% in animals; even the lowest context-specific values remain above 20%.
